# Preview: Huddersfield Town vs Peterborough United - prediction, team news, lineups

By   Matthew Cooper   |

Huddersfield vs Peterborough - prediction, team news, lineups/https%3A%2F%2Fsportsmole-media-prod.s3.gra.io.cloud.ovh.net%2Fuploads%2F2026%2F10%2Fdrury-6ad126879a50f146616134.jpg)

© Iconsport / Mark Fletcher, MI News & Sport / Alamy [...] /https%3A%2F%2Fsportsmole-media-prod.s3.gra.io.cloud.ovh.net%2Fuploads%2F2026%2F10%2Fpeterborough-manager-robbie-savage-pictured-in-september-2026-crystal-pix-6ad150f2b89ac036111657.jpg)

© Imago / Crystal Pix

Peterborough are enjoying a renewed run of form under new boss Robbie Savage, who has picked up two wins and one draw in his first three games in charge. [...] Archie Collins and Cameron Humphreys are set to start in midfield, with Ilias Bronkhorst and Bali Mumba featuring out wide.

Peterborough, meanwhile, could reward Garbett with a start after his late equaliser on Saturday and drop Harry Ashfield to the bench.

Harry Leonard is expected to start up front, with Edwards and Bolu Shofowoke continuing out wide.
